name: MineMeBoost
description: MineMenu and MineBoost in one mod. Right Shift opens a menu with two tabs: MineMenu (60+ singleplayer cheats: noclip, zoom, tame anything, chest ESP, waypoints, time and weather...) and MineBoost (FPS boost with an Intel iGPU preset, Idle Mode and benchmark compare; works alongside Sodium and friends). The . key still opens MineBoost directly.
